# WeaveLLM — Copilot Instructions

## Build & Test

```bash
# Build entire solution
dotnet build WeaveLLM.sln --configuration Release

# Run all tests
dotnet test WeaveLLM.sln --configuration Release --verbosity normal

# Run a single test project
dotnet test tests/WeaveLLM.Core.Tests/ --verbosity normal

# Pack a specific NuGet package
dotnet pack src/WeaveLLM.Core/WeaveLLM.Core.csproj --configuration Release --output ./nupkgs
```

CI publishes to NuGet automatically when a `v*` tag is pushed to `main`. Packing (no publish) runs on every push to `main`.

---

## Architecture

```
WeaveLLM.Core                          ← All interfaces, models, base types. No vendor dependencies.
WeaveLLM.Providers                     ← IChatModel implementations (OpenAI, Anthropic). Raw HttpClient only.
WeaveLLM.Observability                 ← OpenTelemetry ActivitySource + Meter + LLM evaluators.
WeaveLLM.Extensions.DependencyInjection ← Fluent WeaveLLMBuilder over IServiceCollection.
samples/                               ← Usage examples (not in solution test run).
tests/                                 ← WeaveLLM.Core.Tests, WeaveLLM.Agents.Tests, WeaveLLM.RAG.Tests.
```

**Dependency direction:** `Providers` → `Core`. `DI` → `Providers` + `Core`. `Observability` → `Core`. Nothing depends on `Observability` or `DI` — they are opt-in layers.

`WeaveLLM.Core` only references `Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions`, `Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.Abstractions`, and `System.Text.Json`. Keep it that way — no vendor SDKs in Core.

---

## Key Conventions

### `ChainResult<T>` — errors as values, never throw
All async operations return `ChainResult<T>`. Do not throw from chain or provider implementations; return `ChainResult<T>.Failure(...)` instead.

```csharp
var result = await model.ChatAsync(messages);
if (result.IsSuccess)
    Console.WriteLine(result.Value!.Content);
else
    Console.WriteLine($"{result.Error!.Code}: {result.Error.Message}");

// Supports deconstruction and mapping:
var stringResult = result.Map(m => m.Content);
var (ok, value, error) = result;
```

Use the static factory methods on `WeaveLLMError` for structured codes: `Timeout`, `RateLimited`, `InvalidInput`, `ProviderError`.

### `IChain<TInput, TOutput>` — the atomic unit
Every unit of work implements `IChain<TInput, TOutput>`. Use `IConnectableChain<TInput, TOutput>` when the chain needs to be composed via `.Pipe<TNext>()` or wrapped with `.WithMiddleware(...)`.

Built-in middleware lives in `WeaveLLM.Core.Chains`: `RetryMiddleware<TInput, TOutput>` (exponential backoff) and `CacheMiddleware<TInput, TOutput>` (in-memory, keyed by chain name + input hash).

### `ChainContext` — the pipeline's shared carrier
Always thread `ChainContext` through every `ExecuteAsync` / `StreamAsync` call. It carries `TraceId`, `SessionId`, `UserId`, `ILogger`, typed `Variables`, and the `ExecutionHistory`. Create with `ChainContext.Create(userId, logger)`.

### `AgentGraph<TState>` — multi-agent orchestration
`TState` must be a `class` with a `new()` constraint. Nodes are either `IGraphNode<TState>` implementations or inline `Func<TState, ChainContext, CancellationToken, Task<TState>>` delegates. Conditional routing uses a string key that maps to a node name via `RouteMap`. Always call `SetEntryPoint()` and `SetEndPoint()` before `RunAsync()`.

### `[LLMTool]` attribute — zero-boilerplate tool registration
Decorate public instance methods with `[LLMTool("tool_name", "description")]`. Use `[Description("...")]` on parameters for schema generation. Call `registry.RegisterFromObject(new MyTools())` to auto-discover. JSON schema is generated by reflection — parameter types map to JSON Schema types via `GetJsonType()` in `ToolRegistry`.

### Provider implementations
Providers use raw `HttpClient` — no OpenAI/Anthropic SDK dependencies. The `baseUrl` constructor parameter makes every provider compatible with Azure OpenAI, local Ollama proxies, and custom endpoints. When adding a new provider, implement `IChatModel` (which extends `ILanguageModel`) and place it under `src/WeaveLLM.Providers/<ProviderName>/`.

### `LLMOptions` and `Message` static factories
Use the preset factories rather than constructing directly:
- `LLMOptions.Deterministic()`, `LLMOptions.Creative()`, `LLMOptions.Balanced()`
- `Message.System(...)`, `Message.User(...)`, `Message.Assistant(...)`, `Message.Tool(..., toolCallId)`

### Configuration keys (appsettings / environment)
```
WeaveLLM:OpenAI:ApiKey
WeaveLLM:OpenAI:ModelId       (default: gpt-4o)
WeaveLLM:Anthropic:ApiKey
WeaveLLM:Anthropic:ModelId    (default: claude-sonnet-4-5)
```

### Project settings (all packages)
- `TargetFramework`: `net8.0`
- `Nullable`: `enable`
- `ImplicitUsings`: `enable`
- `LangVersion`: `latest`
- All public API types and members must have XML doc comments (`<summary>` at minimum).
